title: Medical Imaging Classification with Cold-Atom Reservoir Computing using Auto-Encoders and Surrogate-Driven Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.06727v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline, based on neutral-atom reservoir computing, for medical image classification, focusing on the binary classification task of polyp detection. To deal effectively with the high dimensionality, we integrate a guided auto-encoder. This pipeline learns compact and discriminative representations of image data that are also well-suited for quantum reservoir computing. A key challenge in such systems is the non-differentiable nature of quantum measurements, which creates a 'gradient barrier' for standard training. We overcome this barrier by incorporating a differentiable surrogate model that emulates the quantum layer, enabling end-to-end backpropagation through the entire system. This guided training process is jointly optimized for classification accuracy and for faithful image recovery from the auto-encoder. The learned latent representations are encoded as pulse detuning parameters within

translated_title: 基于自编码器与代理驱动训练的冷原子储备池计算医学影像分类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于中性原子储备池计算的量子-经典混合流水线，用于医学图像分类，重点关注息肉检测这一二元分类任务。为了有效应对高维数据问题，我们集成了一个引导式自编码器。该流水线能够学习图像数据的紧凑且具有判别性的表示，这些表示也非常适合量子储备池计算。此类系统的一个关键挑战在于量子测量的不可微性，这为标准训练造成了“梯度障碍”。我们通过引入一个可微分代理模型来模拟量子层，从而克服了这一障碍，实现了对整个系统的端到端反向传播。这一引导式训练过程针对分类准确率和自编码器的忠实图像重建进行联合优化。学习到的潜在表示被编码为脉冲失谐参数……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合引导式自编码器与可微分代理模型的冷原子储备池计算混合框架，克服了量子测量不可微带来的梯度障碍，实现了医学影像（息肉检测）分类任务的端到端训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid quantum-classical cold-atom reservoir computing pipeline with a guided auto-encoder and a differentiable surrogate model, overcoming the gradient barrier of non-differentiable quantum measurements to enable end-to-end training for medical image classification (polyp detection).
